fields.name: present
fields.description: 1 when this slot holds a creature, 0 when empty.

fields.description: x offset, as a fraction of vision radius (+ = east).

fields.name: dy
fields.description: y offset, as a fraction of vision radius (+ = south).

fields.name: energy
fields.description: Energy as a fraction of max energy.

fields.name: ready

fields.name: blue
